product_overview: A security administration module for authenticating users and managing access control across users, roles, permissions, pages, and data scope. It also provides self-service account flows for signup, activation, password recovery, and reset.
core_goals: Sign in to access the application and reach the dashboard
Create and activate a new account
Recover access by requesting and completing a password reset
Manage users, roles, permissions, and page registry entries
Assign page permissions and role-based access rules
Configure user profiles and branch-level data scope

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate a user with username and password and take them into the authenticated area of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /(login) -> Fill in username -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /(login) -> Fill in incorrect username or password -> Submit login form -> See an authentication error and remain on the login screen

features.name: User Signup
features.description: Create a new account that starts in a disabled state until it is activated.
user_flows: Navigate to /(login) -> Switch to the signup tab -> Fill in username, email, and password -> Submit the signup form -> See a message that the account needs activation
Navigate to /(login) -> Switch to the signup tab -> Fill in an already-used username or email along with the other required fields -> Submit the signup form -> See a validation error

features.name: Account Activation
features.description: Activate a newly created account using an activation code or token.
user_flows: Navigate to /(login) -> Switch to the account activation tab -> Enter the activation code or token -> Submit the activation form -> See a success confirmation and know the account can now be used to log in
Navigate to /(login) -> Switch to the account activation tab -> Enter an invalid or expired activation code -> Submit the activation form -> See an error message

features.name: Forgot Password
features.description: Request a password reset message by submitting an account email.
user_flows: Navigate to /(login) -> Switch to the forgot password tab -> Enter the account email -> Submit the request -> See a confirmation message
Navigate to /(login) -> Switch to the forgot password tab -> Enter any email address -> Submit the request -> See the same confirmation message regardless of whether the email exists

features.name: Reset Password
features.description: Set a new password using a reset token received out of band.
user_flows: Navigate to /(login) -> Switch to the reset password tab -> Enter the reset token and new password -> Submit the reset form -> See a success confirmation and know the new password can be used to log in
Navigate to /(login) -> Switch to the reset password tab -> Enter an invalid or expired token -> Submit the reset form -> See an error message

features.name: Dashboard Landing
features.description: Provide the authenticated landing page and entry points to other modules.
user_flows: Log in successfully -> Arrive at the dashboard -> Choose a navigation card or link -> Open the selected module screen

features.name: Security Users Management
features.description: Search, create, edit, and delete user accounts, plus view profile details and manage assigned roles and data scope.
user_flows: Navigate to /(sec-users) -> Type a search term or apply filters -> See the user list narrow to matching results
Navigate to /(sec-users) -> Start creating a new user -> Fill in required user fields -> Submit the form -> See the new user appear in the list
Navigate to /(sec-users) -> Open a user for editing -> Change user details -> Save changes -> See the updated user information in the list
Navigate to /(sec-users) -> Open a user for editing -> Open the assigned roles picker -> Change the roles -> Save changes -> See the selected roles reflected for the user
Navigate to /(sec-users) -> Choose to delete a user -> Confirm the action -> See the user removed from the list
Navigate to /(sec-users) -> Open the profile drawer for a user -> Review or change profile details -> Save -> Reopen the drawer and see the values restored
Navigate to /(sec-users) -> Open the data scope drawer for a user or role -> Change the branch access level -> Save changes

features.name: Security Roles and RBAC Management
features.description: Search, create, edit, activate, deactivate, and delete roles, and manage page-level permissions for each role.
user_flows: Navigate to /(sec-roles) -> Type a search term or apply filters -> See the role list narrow to matching results
Navigate to /(sec-roles) -> Start creating a new role -> Fill in required role fields -> Submit the form -> See the new role appear in the list
Navigate to /(sec-roles) -> Open a role for editing -> Change the role details -> Save changes -> See the updated role information persist
Navigate to /(sec-roles) -> Deactivate an active role -> Confirm the action -> See the role status change to inactive
Navigate to /(sec-roles) -> Activate an inactive role -> See the role status change back to active
Navigate to /(sec-roles) -> Open the permission matrix drawer for a role -> Toggle page permission values -> Save changes -> Reopen the drawer and confirm the edits persisted

Navigate to /(sec-roles) -> Open the permission matrix drawer for a role -> Choose to copy permissions from another role -> Confirm the copy -> See the target role reflect the source role's page permissions
Navigate to /(sec-roles) -> Open the permission matrix drawer for a role -> Remove a page permission row -> Save changes -> Reopen the drawer and confirm whether the page remains present

features.name: Security Permissions Registry
features.description: Search, create, and edit raw permission records, including filtering by module.
user_flows: Navigate to /(sec-permissions) -> Type a search term -> Apply a module filter -> See the permission list narrow to matching results
Navigate to /(sec-permissions) -> Start creating a new permission -> Fill in the required code, module, and description -> Submit the form -> See the new permission appear in the list
Navigate to /(sec-permissions) -> Open a permission for editing -> Change the permission name or description -> Save changes -> See the updates persist

features.name: Security Page Registry
features.description: Search, create, edit, deactivate, and reactivate page registry entries that drive role-based access and menu construction.
user_flows: Navigate to /(sec-pages) -> Type a search term or apply filters -> See the page registry results narrow down
Navigate to /(sec-pages) -> Start creating a new page -> Fill in the required page details -> Submit the form -> See the new page appear in the list and its permissions generated
Navigate to /(sec-pages) -> Open an existing page for editing -> Change the page details -> Save changes -> See the updates persist
Navigate to /(sec-pages) -> Deactivate an active page -> Confirm the action -> See the page become inactive
Navigate to /(sec-pages) -> Reactivate an inactive page -> See the page become active again

features.name: User Profile Drawer
features.description: View and edit extended profile data for a user, including full name, employee ID, and preferred language.
user_flows: Navigate to /(sec-users) -> Open a user's profile drawer -> Edit full name or employee ID -> Save changes -> Reopen the drawer and see the values restored
Navigate to /(sec-users) -> Open a user's profile drawer -> Review the branch, language, and active status information -> Close the drawer

features.name: Role Data Scope Management
features.description: Assign branch-level data access rules to roles and manage the allowed access level for each branch assignment.
user_flows: Navigate to /(sec-roles) -> Open the role data scope drawer -> Add a branch assignment -> Choose a data access level -> Save changes -> See the role-branch assignment appear
Navigate to /(sec-roles) -> Open the role data scope drawer -> Edit a branch assignment -> Change the access level or active status -> Save changes -> See the updated assignment in the list

features.name: Notification Inbox
features.description: View and manage a local, UI-only notification inbox.
user_flows: Navigate to /(notif-inbox) -> Review the notification list -> Open a notification -> See its details
Navigate to /(notif-inbox) -> Mark a notification as read or unread -> See its status change in the inbox
Navigate to /(notif-inbox) -> Delete a notification -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Notification Templates
features.description: Create and manage notification templates in local UI state.
user_flows: Navigate to /(notif-templates) -> Start creating a new template -> Fill in template details -> Save -> See the template appear in the list
Navigate to /(notif-templates) -> Open a template for editing -> Change its content or metadata -> Save -> See the updates reflected in the list
Navigate to /(notif-templates) -> Delete a template -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Notification Channels
features.description: Create and manage notification channels in local UI state.
user_flows: Navigate to /(notif-channels) -> Start creating a new channel -> Fill in channel details -> Save -> See the channel appear in the list
Navigate to /(notif-channels) -> Open a channel for editing -> Change its settings -> Save -> See the updates reflected in the list
Navigate to /(notif-channels) -> Delete a channel -> See it removed from the list

tech_stack: Custom design-system UI kit (Button, Table, FormControls, Drawer, Toast, Pagination)

routes.description: Single-page app, no URL router — App.tsx gates the whole UI on isAuthenticated and switches screens via an in-memory navigation store (useNavigationStore.currentScreen), not real URLs. Unauthenticated users always see Login; authenticated users see AppShell with the screen matching currentScreen.
Login screen, containing tabs for Login, Signup, Activate account, Forgot password, and Reset password (all client-side tabs on one screen, not separate URLs).
Landing screen after login; navigation entry point to other modules.
Security > Users list/search/create/edit/delete, with drawers for profile and role assignment.
Security > Roles list/search/create/edit/deactivate/activate, permission-matrix drawer, copy-permissions-from-role, data-scope drawer.
Notifications inbox — mock/local-state only, not backend-connected.
Notification templates — mock/local-state only, not backend-connected.
Notification channels — mock/local-state only, not backend-connected.

known_limitations.issue: Role permission-matrix "remove page" action does not persist
known_limitations.impact: Removing a page from a role's permission matrix appears to succeed in the UI but the removal is not saved server-side; reopening the drawer still shows the page. Confirmed in the 2026-08-28 TestSprite run.

known_limitations.issue: Copy-permissions-from-role action shows no visible effect or feedback
known_limitations.impact: Triggering copy-from-role does not visibly update the target role's matrix or show a success/failure indicator, even though the related bulk "Sync All" action works. Confirmed in the 2026-08-28 TestSprite run.

known_limitations.issue: Assigned Roles picker in the Edit User dialog is unresponsive
known_limitations.impact: The picker is unclickable, blocking role assignment/reassignment for a user entirely from the UI. Confirmed in the 2026-08-28 TestSprite run.

known_limitations.issue: User Profile Drawer edits do not persist
known_limitations.impact: Editing Full Name / Employee ID and saving appears to succeed but the values revert on reopening the drawer. Confirmed in the 2026-08-28 TestSprite run.

known_limitations.issue: Permissions search + module filter combo returns zero results
known_limitations.impact: Searching with both a text query and a module filter applied returns no results even for permissions known to exist, while the equivalent Page Registry search works correctly — likely a module-code mismatch specific to the permissions search request. Confirmed in the 2026-08-28 TestSprite run.

known_limitations.issue: Notifications module is UI-only, not connected to backend API
known_limitations.impact: Inbox/templates/channels are mock/local-state only; changes are not persisted server-side.
